grid_definition: Each city extent is independently divided into 30 equal-width bins per axis from the observed 1-km source-cell centroids; physical bin widths differ by city and no fixed-km grid is used.
category_definition: Each displayed category is a parent landscape family that groups semantically related dimension labels in the current provisional hierarchy.
cell_metric: Within-cell share of sampled panoramas with at least one recurrent SAE combination containing an eligible unit from that family; each panorama contributes at most once per category.
bubble_area: Proportional to within-cell matching-panorama share; a common 0-100% area scale is used across all six cities and all category pages.
proportion_definition: Category-matching sampled panoramas divided by all sampled panoramas assigned to the normalized bin.
sampling: Based on the selected panorama sample and assigned to normalized bins by source 1-km cell centroid.
limitations: Shares are panorama-level family responses, not physical object prevalence.
Categories and recurrent SAE combinations remain exploratory and are not human-validated.

higher_resolution_detail.reason: Separate 1-km detail views for three cities; these are not included in the six-city main atlas.

combination_classes.class_definition: Unordered combination of semantic parent families; each class groups mutually exclusive subtype-level recurrent SAE-response patterns under the one-unit-per-family assignment.
combination_classes.rate_definition: Mean across cities of within-city observed 1-km-cell-balanced sampled-panorama rates; response retrieval, not physical object count or validated landscape prevalence.

combination_city_bubbles.grid_definition: Each city extent is independently divided into 30 equal-width bins on each axis from the observed 1-km source-cell centroids; physical bin widths differ by city and no fixed-km grid is used.
combination_city_bubbles.selection: Twenty semantic parent-family signatures ranked by mean city-level cell-balanced panorama rate.
combination_city_bubbles.circle_area: Proportional to the within-bin share of sampled panoramas matching the class; a fixed 0-100% area scale is shared across all six cities and all class pages.
combination_city_bubbles.circle_color: One stable unique darkened tab20 color per combination class; class labels and matching size legends are repeated on each page.
combination_city_bubbles.proportion_definition: Matching sampled panorama count divided by all sampled panoramas in the normalized bin.
combination_city_bubbles.counts_are: SAE-response shares, not physical object prevalence or validated landscape prevalence.
